summary:
**Project Summary – Cleo**

Cleo is an AI-powered astronaut health and companionship system designed to address the physiological and psychological challenges of long-duration space missions. In the confined environment of space, sleep deprivation, fatigue, isolation, and monotony can gradually impact crew well-being and mission performance.

Cleo tackles these challenges through two integrated features. Its health-monitoring website centralizes astronaut biometrics and sleep trends, using historical NASA health data to help astronauts recognize patterns, understand their current well-being, and develop greater personal health awareness. Complementing this, Cleo's AI companion provides personalized conversations, daily check-ins, and recommendations to help reduce monotony and provide companionship during periods of isolation.

Rather than simply responding to health concerns after they arise, Cleo emphasizes early awareness and proactive well-being. By combining personalized health insights with accessible AI companionship, Cleo aims to support healthier, more resilient crews on long-duration space missions.
details:
Project Details – Cleo

Cleo is an AI-powered astronaut health and companionship system designed to address the physiological and psychological challenges of long-duration space missions. It combines a health-monitoring website with an AI companion to support astronauts living in isolated and confined environments.

How it works: Cleo has two main components. First, its website centralizes astronaut health information, displaying biometric data and sleep trends informed by historical NASA astronaut health data. This helps astronauts recognize patterns, understand their current well-being, and develop greater awareness of their health. Second, Cleo's AI companion provides personalized conversations, daily check-ins, and recommendations to help astronauts manage monotony and feelings of isolation.

Benefits and intended impact: By bringing health information into one accessible platform, Cleo complements the role of the Crew Medical Officer (CMO) and encourages proactive health awareness. Its companion component provides consistent interaction and personalized engagement, helping make the psychological challenges of confinement more manageable. Ultimately, Cleo aims to support healthier, more resilient astronauts and contribute to safer, more sustainable long-duration space missions.

Tools and development: Our team developed a web-based platform alongside an AI-powered conversational companion. The project brings together web development, data visualization, and artificial intelligence to create an accessible astronaut support system.

Creativity and considerations: What makes Cleo unique is its approach to addressing both sides of astronaut well-being through one integrated solution. Rather than focusing exclusively on physical health or mental health, we considered how isolation, disrupted sleep, fatigue, and monotony can interact and affect overall crew performance. We designed Cleo around accessibility, personalization, astronaut autonomy, and the importance of early awareness rather than waiting for problems to develop.
